theorem unitSphere_isMaxOn_laplacian_nonpos
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {f : E → ℝ} {w : E}
    (directions : ι → E) (diagonal : ι → ℝ) (laplacian : ℝ)
    (hw : ‖w‖ = 1)
    (htangent : ∀ i, ⟪w, directions i⟫_ℝ = 0)
    (hmax : IsMaxOn f (Metric.sphere (0 : E) 1) w)
    (hcontinuous : ∀ i, ContinuousAt
      (fun t : ℝ => f (unitSphereExp w (t • directions i))) 0)
    (hdiagonal : ∀ i, diagonal i =
      deriv (deriv (fun t : ℝ =>
        f (unitSphereExp w (t • directions i)))) 0)
    (htrace : laplacian = ∑ i, diagonal i) :
    laplacian ≤ 0
approved_definition_context: The index type is finite and E is a real inner-product space.
The base point has unit norm and every supplied direction is orthogonal to it.
The function has a global maximum on the unit sphere at the base point.
Each curve restriction is continuous at zero; the diagonal and trace identities are supplied explicitly.
